Forget McDonalds, give this a try
Jan 2026 • Couples
This was a great little find. We fancied a change from noodle type dishes and found this great little place. It is tucked away off the main drag in a turning almost apposite the Arts Nest Hotel. 
We ate inside as the outside tables were taken. We both had regular burger & chips, which was beautiful and very reasonably priced. We were supplied thin plastic gloves to protect our hands from the juices from the burger, which was a first for us. 
I’d have given it 5 stars, but the fact that I’m a very fussy person and the odd chip wasn’t up to my very high standard, but I am being really picky here. 
The ambiance isn’t great, it has that cafe feel, but please don’t let that put you off, we really enjoyed our meal. I’d definitely go back again.
